description:
About Kivo

Kivo Health is a series A healthcare AI company delivering AI-powered care to seniors with chronic disease, starting with chronic lung disease (COPD). Backed by top tier investors, including YCombinator, Kivo is growing fast towards achieving its mission to help 1 billion seniors breathe easier and live better.

About the role

As an Exercise Physiologist at Kivo Health, you'll lead virtual pulmonary rehabilitation sessions for patients managing COPD and related chronic lung conditions. We work hard, move quickly, and have a lot of fun doing it. The right candidate brings clinical rigor, comfort with remote care delivery, and genuine investment in patient outcomes.

This position is 100% remote, work from anywhere in the U.S.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead engaging virtual pulmonary rehab sessions

  • Develop and tailor exercise prescriptions and treatment plans

  • Monitor and adjust patient programs based on progress and clinical status

  • Educate patients on breathing techniques, energy conservation, and self-care

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to support patient outcomes

  • Maintain accurate documentation and contribute to program improvement

Who you are

  • You work with autonomy in your day-to-day caseload, while team leads, clinical directors, and physicians remain available for guidance and oversight

  • You communicate clearly with patients and just as clearly with your care team, translating clinical detail into plain language on one side and precise documentation on the other

  • You pick up new tools quickly and don't get rattled when tech hiccups mid-session, you adapt and keep the patient's experience smooth

  • Evidence-based practice (ATS/ACSM/AACVPR standards) guides your clinical decisions by default

  • You make sound clinical judgment calls even when a situation doesn't match the textbook case

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Degree in Exercise Physiology (clinical track)

  • 2+ years of experience in pulmonary or cardiopulmonary rehab (virtual or in-person)

  • Current BLS certification

  • Willingness to complete AACVPR PR certification (within 3 months) and ACSM-CEP certification (within 6 months)

  • Strong communication and technology skills

  • Experience with virtual PR, and bilingual English/Spanish, both a plus

Technology and Connectivity Requirements

The clinician is responsible for monitoring patient safety in real time, so a reliable internet connection is an essential function of the job.

Clinicians must have:

  • Home internet with at least [10 Mbps upload and 25 Mbps download], tested from the workspace used for sessions

  • A wired (ethernet) connection to the router during patient sessions, or an equivalent stable connection approved by the clinical lead

  • A backup internet option, such as a mobile hotspot, available during all scheduled sessions

  • A private, quiet workspace suitable for protected health information

[Candidates will be asked to verify their connection during the interview process. Employees must maintain these standards throughout employment. Repeated connection failures that interrupt patient sessions may result in corrective action, up to and including termination.]

Compensation and benefits

  • $31/hour, full-time

  • Healthcare benefits & PTO

  • Monday –Friday schedule

  • Opportunity for growth within the organization

Kivo Health is committed to providing fair, competitive, and transparent compensation. The final offer for this role is determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s unique experience, skillset, education, certifications, and geographic location.

We believe in hiring practices that are equitable and inclusive. Kivo Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities during the recruitment process.
